name: Sunny Friend Environmental Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sunny Friend Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the bio-medical waste incineration business in Taiwan. The company is involved in the collection, incineration, solidification, physicochemical, and landfill of hazardous waste, as well as treatment of hazardous industrial waste, infectious medical, general waste, and general industrial waste business. It also provides pollution control and waste disposal equipment. In addition, the company engages in installation of engineering, environmental engineering consulting activities.
